description_en: Modifies the network options of an instance
kebab_example: aliyun ecs modify-instance-network-options --instance-id i-bp67acfmxazb4p0000 --bandwidth-weighting Vpc-L1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyInstanceNetworkOptions

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the instance for which you want to modify the network bandwidth weight
parameters.help_zh: 待修改网络带宽权重的实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The bandwidth weight.

The supported values vary by instance type. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2679699.html to query the bandwidth weight values supported by the current instance type
parameters.help_zh:
带宽权重。

不同规格支持设置的值不一样，您可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2679699.html查询当前实例规格支持的带宽权重值
parameters.name: bandwidth_weighting

TaskId.description_en:
The ID of the task for modifying the bandwidth weight.

You can call [DescribeTaskAttribute]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2679968.html） to query the result of the bandwidth weight modification
TaskId.description_zh:
修改带宽权重的任务ID。

您可以使用[DescribeTaskAttribute]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2679968.html）接口修改带宽权重结果
